source: If they can get a Bryan-Watson ticket on the ballot, good for them. We will sort this issue out after we win the election in November.
zh: 如果他们能在选票上获得布赖恩-Watson 票，对他们有好处。我们将在 11 月份赢得选举后解决这个问题。

source: It's a shame that this policy wasn't implemented decades ago. For too long, rural Americans have been forced to travel up to thirty miles to retrieve the mail they are entitled to.
zh: 遗憾的是这项政策几十年前没有实施。长期以来，美国农村地区的人们被迫长途跋涉三十英里来取回他们有权领取的邮件。

source: We should monitor this program very carefully to determine if it can be done in a cost-effective manner.
zh: 我们应该非常仔细地监控该计划，以确定它是否可以以具有成本效益的方式完成。

source: This policy will hurt the small storeowner and serves as yet another example of wasteful government spending. We should be looking to reduce the deficit -- not to add new programs.
zh: 这项政策将伤害小店主，并成为浪费政府支出的又一个例子。我们应该寻求减少赤字——而不是增加新项目。

source: The current system for selecting Senators is unimaginably corrupt. State legislatures have every incentive to select the most corrupt, retrograde candidate for the job.
zh: 当前的参议员选举制度腐败得难以想象。州立法机构有充分的动机选择最腐败、最倒行逆施的候选人担任该职位。

source: I neither support, nor do I oppose this idea for an Amendment. My job as President will be to enforce the law as it stands.
zh: 我既不支持也不反对这个修正案的想法。作为总统，我的工作就是执行现行法律。

source: The purpose of the Senate is to act as an objective legislative body. It is dangerous to tamper with the Constitutional provisions established by our founding fathers.
zh: 参议院的目的是充当客观的立法机构。篡改我们的开国元勋制定的宪法条款是危险的。

source: At the very least, a federal law prohibiting the sale of alcohol of Sunday seems appropriate.
zh: 至少，禁止周日销售酒精的联邦法律似乎是合适的。

source: This debate has no place in our system of federalism. The individual states have every right to decide how they wish to handle the issue of commerce and drinking on Sunday.
zh: 这场辩论在我们的联邦制体系中没有地位。各州完全有权决定如何处理周日的商业和饮酒问题。

source: I don't support the mandated closing of shops on Sunday.
zh: 我不支持周日强制关闭商店。

source: I envision an American canal, built by American workers, property of the American government, supporting the actions of a robust American Navy. I fully support these plans.
zh: 我设想一条由美国工人建造的美国运河，属于美国政府的财产，支持强大的美国海军的行动。我完全支持这些计划。

source: This could be a fantastic method of creating work for our idle workers. What better way is there to implement a massive public works project?
zh: 这可能是为闲散工人创造工作的绝佳方法。还有什么更好的方法来实施大型公共工程项目呢？

source: Am I understand that we will be sending thousands of men to dig through the hills of Nicaragua on this pipe dream of a project? Allow me to predict that there will never be a canal in that country.
zh: 我是否理解，我们将派遣数千人在尼加拉瓜的山上挖掘这个白日梦项目？请允许我预测那个国家永远不会有运河。

source: Senators should be selected by state legislatures. Why on earth would you want to debase the dignity of that body?
zh: 参议员应由州立法机构选出。你到底为什么要贬低那个身体的尊严？

source: Boies is a controversial figure to be sure, but he more or less falls into line with your traditional views. Of course, there are a lot of states besides Iowa you need to visit if you're to have a chance...
zh: 博伊斯确实是一个有争议的人物，但他或多或少符合你的传统观点。当然，如果你有机会的话，除了艾奥瓦州之外还有很多州你需要去参观......

source: It's a bit much to say that Boies's day is over, although he is a bit past his political prime.
zh: 说博伊斯的日子已经结束有点过分了，尽管他已经过了他的政治巅峰期。

source: Iowa is a key state and this should help you there.
zh: 艾奥瓦州是一个关键状态，这应该对您有所帮助。

source: You can't even get your answer right on the mail issue? Farmers want free mail and they're tired of being ripped off by local storeowners.
zh: 您甚至无法在邮件问题上得到正确的答案吗？农民想要免费邮件，他们厌倦了被当地店主欺骗。

source: Do you approve of Grover Cleveland's handing of the federal budget over the previous four years?
zh: 您是否赞成格罗弗·克利夫兰过去四年对联邦预算的处理？

source: What do you say to the notion that high tariffs hurt farmers?
zh: 对于高关税伤害农民的观点，您有何看法？

source: What are your thoughts on the Women's Christian Temperance Union? Is this group a positive force in American life?
zh: 您对基督教妇女禁酒联盟有何看法？这个群体是美国生活中的积极力量吗？

source: Does the success of the tin-plate industry within the U.S. prove that protectionism stimulates industry?
zh: 美国镀锡板行业的成功是否证明保护主义刺激了行业？

source: Are you pleased with the recent defeat in Congress of the Pacific Railroad Funding Bill, which would have provided federal support to the Southern and Central Pacific railroads.
zh: 您对太平洋铁路资助法案最近在国会失败感到满意吗？该法案将为南太平洋和中太平洋铁路提供联邦支持。

source: This is the type of cronyism that occurs when government selects certain industries for protection under a tariff act. I support low tariffs across the board.
zh: 这是当政府根据关税法案选择某些行业进行保护时发生的任人唯亲行为。我全面支持低关税。

source: I'm glad for the men who produce tin for a living, but we need to consider the overall effect of this policy. I don't have a glib answer for you at this point.
zh: 我为那些以生产锡为生的人感到高兴，但我们需要考虑这项政策的整体效果。目前我还没有一个圆滑的答案给你。

source: There is nothing I'm more proud of from my time in Congress than creating the conditions that allowed for a booming tin industry to flourish within our borders.
zh: 在国会任职期间，没有什么比为锡工业在我国境内蓬勃发展创造条件更让我感到自豪的了。

source: The answer here is obvious. High tariffs force farmers to purchase overpriced equipment and do nothing to increase crop prices.
zh: 这里的答案是显而易见的。高关税迫使农民购买价格过高的设备，却无助于提高农作物价格。

source: Perhaps. It depends on if these tariffs cause other countries to retaliate against our agricultural goods. This is always a risk when tariffs are increased in haphazard fashion.
zh: 也许吧。这取决于这些关税是否会导致其他国家对我们的农产品进行报复。当关税随意增加时，这始终是一个风险。

source: High tariffs protect American industry and increase the purchasing power of the consumer. Free silver would throw this system into chaos and even hurt the farmer in the long-term.
zh: 高关税保护美国工业并提高消费者的购买力。自由铸银会使这个系统陷入混乱，甚至从长远来看会伤害农民。

source: The WCTU is one of the most spiritually uplifting, morally righteous groups in our society. I pray that the Lord will see fit to guide them to success in their mission.
zh: WCTU 是我们社会中精神最振奋、道德最正义的团体之一。我祈祷主会认为适当地引导他们在他们的使命中取得成功。

source: This is a well-meaning group of honest Christian women. I am neither especially opposed to nor especially supportive of their goals.
zh: 这是一群善意的诚实基督教女性。我既不特别反对也不特别支持他们的目标。

source: This group is Exhibit A in the dangers of allowing women to become politically active. They are engaged in a naive quest to purify American life from an imagined evil.
zh: 这个群体是允许女性积极参与政治的危险的证据 A。他们天真地致力于净化美国人的生活，使其免受想象中的邪恶的侵害。

source: Grover Cleveland has vetoed more pieces of legislation than any President in our history, increased our deficit, and still found a way to provide J.P. Morgan with a financial windfall from the public purse.
zh: 格罗弗·克利夫兰否决的立法比我们历史上任何一位总统都多，增加了我们的赤字，并且仍然找到了一种方法，可以从公共资金中为摩根大通提供意外之财。

source: Is there anyone left in the United States who approves of Grover Cleveland? We need to move on from his failed Administration.
zh: 美国还有人支持格罗弗·克利夫兰吗？我们需要从他失败的政府中继续前进。

source: Grover Cleveland is a citizen of integrity who has done his best under trying circumstances. He was simply found to be not up to the job.
zh: 格罗弗·克利夫兰是一位正直的公民，他在艰难的环境下竭尽全力。他只是被发现无法胜任这份工作。

source: I will stand up for Grover Cleveland for the rest of my life. I believe that he is a great man whom our history will greatly vindicate.
zh: 我将在余生中支持格罗弗·克利夫兰。我相信他是一位伟人，我们的历史将极大地证明他是正确的。

source: It is my firm position that we need to nationalize the railroads of this country. Their power has stood beyond reproach for too long.
zh: 我的坚定立场是，我们需要将这个国家的铁路国有化。他们的力量已经无可非议太久了。

source: For all of their talk about small government, the Republicans are quite adept at funneling public money to the railroads. I only support that practice when there is a clear rationale, and in this case the rationale was corruption.
zh: 共和党人嘴上总说要小政府，拿公共资金输送给铁路公司的时候却很在行。我只在理由充分时才支持这种做法，而这一次的理由，就是腐败。

source: Without federal support including loans and land grants, there are certain railroads which would simply be too large to construct with private capital. I was disappointed by the defeat of this bill.
zh: 如果没有联邦政府的支持，包括贷款和土地赠款，某些铁路将太大而无法用私人资本建造。我对这项法案的失败感到失望。

source: I was opposed to this bill. We might have provided land grants and funding for railroads in the past, but that practice will end under my Administration.
zh: 我反对这项法案。我们过去可能为铁路提供了土地补助和资金，但这种做法将在我的政府领导下结束。

source: Don't undermine your own position on the tariff issue. It does no good for anyone.
zh: 不要破坏自己在关税问题上的立场。这对任何人都没有好处。

source: The WCTU is popular in some rural areas, but not in the northern cities that you need to win this fall.
zh: WCTU 在一些农村地区很受欢迎，但在今年秋天你需要赢得胜利的北方城市却不受欢迎。

source: Nationalize the railroads? What has gotten into you? You might as well quit now, you'll never win in November.
zh: 铁路国有化？你怎么了？你最好现在就退出，十一月你永远不会赢。

source: The voters are confused because you used your time in Congress to fight against tariffs.
zh: 选民们很困惑，因为你利用在国会的时间来进行斗争 反对 关税。

source: What are your views on the Darwinian theory of Evolution?
zh: 您对达尔文进化论有何看法？

source:
The respectable city newspapers are unanimously pro-McKinley. As such, William Randolph Hearst senses that supporting you would be a terrific business opportunity.
Can you reassure him that there are limits to your pacifist ideals, particularly in regards to Cuba?
zh:
受人尊敬的城市报纸一致支持麦金莱。因此，威廉·伦道夫·赫斯特 (William Randolph Hearst) 认为支持您将是一个绝佳的商机。
你能否向他保证你的和平主义理想是有限度的，特别是在古巴方面？

source: Governor Altgeld of Illinois has proposed that you appear with him in Chicago for a couple of big speeches. Later on he would appear with you in southern Illinois to solidify his support with rural voters. What do you think of this idea?
zh: 伊利诺伊州州长 Altgeld 建议您与他一起出现在芝加哥进行几次大型演讲。稍后他会和大家一起出现在南部伊利诺伊州，以巩固他在农村选民中的支持。你觉得这个想法怎么样？

source: Without compromising on the silver issue, what can you say about McKinley to Bourbon Democrats to try and bring them back into the fold?
zh: 在不妥协白银问题的情况下，您对麦金莱至波旁民主党人有什么想说的，以尝试让它们重新回归？

source: Altgeld is free to appear with me at any event, but I will not rearrange my entire schedule to suit his needs.
zh: Altgeld 可以自由地与我一起出现在任何活动中，但我不会重新安排我的整个日程以满足他的需要。

source: On many industrial issues, such as the Pullman Strike and his pardon of the Haymarket anarchists, Altgeld is too radical. I would prefer not to appear with him.
zh: 在许多工业问题上，例如普尔曼罢工和他对干草市场无政府主义者的赦免，阿尔特盖德过于激进。我宁愿不和他一起出现。

source: This sounds like a good idea. Farmers and other laborers need to be unified this fall if we're to have a chance of beating McKinley.
zh: 这听起来是个好主意。如果我们想要击败麦金莱，农民和其他劳动者就需要在今年秋天团结起来。

source: I cannot support the exploitation of foreign peoples in good conscience. The Bible states that thou shalt not kill, and that is my position as well.
zh: 我不能凭良心支持对外国人的剥削。圣经规定不可杀人，这也是我的立场。

source: William Randolph Hearst knows my opinions and he is free to endorse me or not endorse me. I will not cater to his whims.
zh: 威廉·伦道夫·赫斯特知道我的意见，他可以自由地支持我或不支持我。我不会迎合他的一时兴起。

source: New York and California are important states, and of course I support the uplift of primitive peoples with American influence. What's not to like in this arrangement?
zh: 纽约州和加利福尼亚州是重要的国家，我当然支持受美国影响的原始民族的崛起。这样的安排有什么理由不喜欢呢？

source: McKinley has proposed some of the most dastardly tariffs to ever see the light of day in this country.
zh: 麦金莱提出了一些在这个国家见过的最卑鄙的关税。

source: McKinley will run a radical pro-monopolist Administration that should frighten any ordinary American.
zh: 麦金莱将领导一个激进的支持垄断的政府，这应该让任何普通美国人感到恐惧。

source: We can all agree that the growth in the deficit is concerning. I will fight for an income tax Amendment that will allow us to close this gap without increasing tariffs.
zh: 我们都同意赤字的增长令人担忧。我将争取所得税修正案，使我们能够在不增加关税的情况下缩小这一差距。

source: With the new perspectives I bring, I will be in a unique position to ensure clean, honest government at the federal level. McKinley, on the other hand, is a Republican hack who will continue the status quo.
zh: 凭借我带来的新视角，我将处于一个独特的位置，以确保联邦层面的廉洁、诚实的政府。另一方面，麦金莱是一位共和党黑客，他将继续维持现状。

source: I agree with the concept of 'survival of the fittest'. It is the destiny of the strong to expand at the expense of the weak.
zh: 我同意“适者生存”的理念。以牺牲弱者为代价来扩张是强者的命运。

source: I have no comment to make on Darwinism. This is completely irrelevant to my expected duties as President of the United States.
zh: 我对达尔文主义没有任何评论。这与我作为美国总统的预期职责完全无关。

source: I'm not convinced of the veracity of this theory. It contravenes accepted Christian teaching in a large number of ways.
zh: 我不相信这个理论的准确性。它在很多方面违背了公认的基督教教义。

source: Evolution teaches disregard for the security and dignity of our fellow man. Left unchecked this 'survival of the fittest' mentality will eventually cause indifference to life itself, from which only calamity can ensue.
zh: 进化论教导我们忽视人类同胞的安全和尊严。如果不加以遏制，这种“适者生存”的心态最终会导致对生命本身的漠视，从而酿成灾难。

source: This is a bad response politically. Social Darwinism is still a minority view, held mainly among the Ivy League upper-crust. You shouldn't imply that you agree with such views.
zh: 这在政治上是一个糟糕的反应。社会达尔文主义仍然是少数人的观点，主要是在常春藤盟校的上层人士中持有的。您不应暗示您同意此类观点。

source: Altgeld is a controversial figure to be sure, but he can greatly help enhance your reputation among urban, immigrant voters.
zh: 阿尔特盖德无疑是一个有争议的人物，但他可以极大地帮助提高您在城市移民选民中的声誉。

source: It sounds like you are running a sensible, moderate campaign. Will the votes in the center be there for you?
zh: 听起来您正在进行一场明智、温和的竞选活动。中间的选票会为你服务吗？

source: This is likely to help you with urban voters, though a few moderates may be turned off by this new allegiance. On the balance, it should be a positive for you.
zh: 这可能会帮助你赢得城市选民的支持，尽管一些温和派可能会对这种新的忠诚感到反感。总的来说，这对你来说应该是积极的。

source: You have shown yourself to be a man of integrity, sticking to the Christian views you have always espoused.
zh: 你表现出自己是一个正直的人，坚持你一直信奉的基督教观点。

source: You have helped yourself in a couple of key states, but at some damage to your pacifist reputation.
zh: 你在几个关键州帮助了自己，但你的和平主义声誉受到了一些损害。

source: This is nothing less than a betrayal of your own essence. You are a Creationist and you always will be.
zh: 这无异于背叛你自己的本质。你是一个神创论者，而且永远都是。
